verdict.rationale: mParticle exposes some documented platform APIs (Audiences API, Warehouse Sync API, Feeds) that support programmatic pipeline interaction, but connecting audiences to outputs/destinations is documented as a manual UI flow (Data Platform > Setup > Directory) rather than API-driven, and there is no evidence of a documented MCP server or full source/destination/stream-wiring API surface for agentic control. missing for 10: MCP server or agent-facing API, API-based source/destination creation and stream wiring (not just UI), delivery inspection API, any hands-on/independent confirmation.
